properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.logging-level
properties.description: Inbound Servlet HTTP logging detail: NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, or FULL. Logging is emitted at INFO when enabled.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.logging-excluded-paths
properties.description: Ant-style application paths excluded from inbound Servlet HTTP logs. The configured list replaces the default.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.request-correlation.enabled
properties.description: Enable inbound request correlation for Spring MVC.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.request-correlation.header-name
properties.description: HTTP header used for inbound request correlation.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.request-correlation.accept-incoming
properties.description: Accept a valid incoming correlation header; invalid or missing values are generated.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.request-correlation.write-response
properties.description: Write the final correlation identifier to the response header.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.request-correlation.maximum-length
properties.description: Maximum accepted correlation-header length, from 36 through 64 characters.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.request-correlation.excluded-paths
properties.description: Ant-style application paths excluded from request correlation.
